text:
Maya Tran: Quick heads-up  pulled weekly KPI board for the May launch. DAU->MQL curve flattens after day 7, looks off vs our 3-launch average :thinking_face:
Evan Cole: saw a blip in the Friday digest. could be late conversions or attribution drift. did anything change in routing/backfills?
Maya Tran: not in the launch plan, but Leah mentioned a partner backfill last week that touched `utm_content` mapping
Leah Park: yep we deployed a small backfill to normalize partner tags (mapped some old partner keys to canonical names). it updated CRM but raw events stayed the same
Jorge Rivas: can you paste the query you used? i'll diff raw-event cohorts vs CRM-backed cohorts and export a CSV
Maya Tran: ```SELECT cohort_day, count(distinct user_id) AS mqls FROM events WHERE launch_id='may_release' AND event='mql' GROUP BY cohort_day;```
Tom B: if dashboard reads raw events but reports to execs pull CRM, that explains mismatch. recommend a metadata badge on pulseboard showing "last attribution change" timestamp
Evan Cole: +1. also a toggle to overlay raw vs crm series (useful for weekly reviews)
ops-bot: leadflow-backfill job completed 2026-03-22T09:23:12Z. rows_processed=7200
Jorge Rivas: ran diffs: raw series shows the day-8 plateau; crm-backed series recovers slightly. delta concentrated in paid/social and partner X where backfill reassigned source
Leah Park: also found ~120 webinar registrants routed via a redirect that strips queries -> shows as `direct`. will pull session-level traces for a 200-user sample
Maya Tran: action list before Monday: Jorge upload CSV diff, Leah session traces, Evan add dashboard annotation + two-line PM blurb, Tom scope metadata badge + overlay toggle
Tom B: can add badge + toggle today (low lift). will include a link to backfill run id
Evan Cole: drafting PM blurb now, will attach CSV link and quick impact estimate (pct of conversion reclassified)
Jorge Rivas: CSV uploaded: https://redwood.internal/files/may_kpi_attrib_diff_315987.csv :link:
Maya Tran: great triage. long-term: add an "attribution parity" test to the weekly KPI pipeline and a pre-launch redirect checklist for webinars
Evan Cole: agreed. schedule a 30m follow-up to codify the checklist? ops-bot you can add a slot
ops-bot: Calendar event created: "KPI attribution parity sync" 2026-03-24T16:00:00Z, duration 30m. invites: Maya Tran, Evan Cole, Jorge Rivas, Leah Park, Tom B
Maya Tran: thanks all. meet in ~2 days. :thumbsup:
